name: Vegan Raspberry Cookies
directions: Mix flaxseed and water and set aside for at least 5 min until thickened
Add butter, sugar and lemon zest into a bowl until light and fluffy
Whip flax egg and vanilla into butter-sugar mixture
Add flour, baking powder, and salt. Mix until thick and slightly sticky
Add frozen chopped raspberries and using a spatula, fold into the cookie dough
Wrap bowl with plastic wrap and put into fridge to chill for 1 hr
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and preheat oven for 350° F
Take dough out of the fridge. Use cookie scoop (~2 TBSP) into 9 cookie dough balls. Place the balls about 2 inches apart on the tray
Bake the cookies for 13-15 min until bottoms are lightly browned
Remove the cookies from the oven and let cool on baking sheet for 5 min
